producerReview.observation: Personally viewed complete saved 1536x1024 proposal. The original room remains recognizable across both halves: desk/chair, wood, lamp table, plants, window/lake and foreground depth are visible around local paper islands rather than hidden by a full-height white sidebar. Character face/fringe, book-holding hands, supported seated pose and complete head/shoes remain visually coherent and in a comparable position/scale; no obvious limb or facial deformation observed, but no pixel-identical preservation claim. Exactly three navigation labels, one small brand, one avatar and one composer with plus/up-arrow are shown, with no activity/weather/status/tooltips. Chinese sample text is legible. Message type and avatar are larger, composer wider, and paper more opaque than intended; refine these in implementation rather than treating generated UI dimensions/material as approved. This is a static composition proposal only, not a functional or responsive runtime check.
